arStrings.szText: "Did the Oracle send you? Who are you?"
Not long ago, I was a just a peasant girl, cursed with ears that hear the dead. Now, I serve the Oracle by listening to them, in the tradition of Rathma.
Modest. Reserved.
It is...a challenging way of life, but I am fortunate. I might have become a Priest of Rathma—a “necromancer” who walks alone with death...
Modest. Honest.
